description: This PHP source file defines the EditTimesheetController class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for handling the editing of timesheets in the Time plugin. It manages rendering the timesheet editing view and access control based on user roles and timesheet state.

classes.name: EditTimesheetController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the editing of timesheets, including rendering the edit view and access control.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and components for rendering the edit timesheet page, including setting component properties based on the timesheet data and current user.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Determines if the current user has permission to access/edit the specified timesheet based on its state and the user's role.
